_readme: LEVEL 1 GUIDE: everything the tutorial says and does. Edit freely; changes apply on the next Play.
Full reference: Documentation/LevelGuideTutorial/README.md. Fields starting with '_' are notes and are ignored.
LESSONS play top to bottom, each ONCE, when their 'when' happens (and 'after' lesson is done). One lesson at a time.
No 'waitFor' = tap to continue (screen dims, player held still).
With 'waitFor' = YOUR TURN: nothing dims, the player does it, and the page ends when it happens (like walking 4 m).
The speech box folds into a small bubble at the top once read (3 s) or as soon as the player starts doing it, so windows stay usable.
style 'hint' = small bubble at the top that never blocks (default: disappears after 5 s). box: auto | top | bottom | center.
Text tokens: {guide} = guide name, {objective} = current objective step.
Portraits: put images (Texture Type: Sprite) in Assets/Resources/Tutorials/Portraits and list them in guide.portraits by mood.
_targets: face (page): the same target names; the view turns smoothly toward it when the page appears (first person), e.g. the Supply Counter or the next waypoint.
hud:objective hud:progress hud:timer hud:minimap hud:notes hud:folder hud:profiles hud:settings hud:icons hud:bag hud:slot hud:book
hud:joystick hud:look hud:prompt hud:exit hud:card hud:continue (the open reward card and its button)
world:<scene path>   type:<ComponentName>   ui:<UI object name>   screen:x,y[,w,h] (0..1)   waypoint
chip = a Tax Code value that an empty case-folder field accepts;  field = the field that takes the value in hand (never Name/TIN)
'revealArrows': true on a page = the objective arrows, goal pin and minimap pin appear from that page on (trail.waitForGuide)
_gestures: tap | drag (from point to 'to') | swipe | joystick | hold | none
_triggers: EVENTS (add #n to need n times): start, lesson:<id>, event:<objective event>, state:<GameState>,
dialogue:start, dialogue:end, value:selected, value:placed, value:rejected, corkboard:placed, corkboard:wrong
near:<metres>:<target>, visible:<target>, profiles:<n>, case:filled, dialogue:active, open:<notes|profiles|folder|bag>, owns:<item id>,
card:<audit|sidequest|level|result|any> (that reward/summary card is open; use duringResults + endIfGone on the lesson),
active:<target> (object is switched on, e.g. the open case folder), not:<condition> (e.g. not:open:notes)
WAIT ONLY: tap, move:<metres>, look:<degrees>, seconds:<n>.   Join with | for 'any of'.

welcome.title: TaxVenture!
welcome.subtitle: LEVEL 1 · YOUR FIRST DAY ON THE JOB
welcome.tagline: Help the townsfolk, crack your first tax case, and earn the town's trust.

_levelCompleteNote: Result-card lessons are ONE tap page each, shown right after the card appears; one tap and the card is yours, no more interruptions. The card's auto-continue waits while it shows.
_waypoints: Where the arrows lead for each objectives.json step. 'step' must match the step's trigger exactly. pick: nearestAvailable | nearest | first.

pages.text: Well hello there, rookie! I'm {guide}. I've been sorting out this town's taxes since before you were born!
Quick tip: when I'm talking, tap anywhere to hear my next line. Same goes for chats with the townsfolk.
First day! We'll start with the plaza and its people, then your first real case in the office.
This card is your progress. EXP grows as you get better at the job, and hearts show how much the town trusts you.
Your minimap! The blue arrow is you, and the yellow diamonds are people. It's 7:30 in the morning, bright and early!
These squares are your carry slots. Whatever you pick up today lands here, ready to use.
And Settings, for the sound and controls.
Put your left thumb on the joystick and push it to walk.
Nice moves! You're a natural.
Now slide your right thumb across the right side of the screen to look around.
Perfect! That's the whole plaza. Walk and look together, and you can go anywhere.
One more thing before we head out: your Bag. Tap it to open it.
Empty for now. When your slots are full, things wait in here. Tap BACK to close it.
Let's put those thumbs to work! There's a small chest near the trees. Walk over and open it.

lessons.title: YOUR NOTES
lessons._note: T16 chest revision: the physical paper is collected before the store and before the town route. Existing receptionist grants stay independent and still establish case-received.

pages.text: There it is! Tap the paper to pick it up.
Whoosh! Today's Notes flew into your slot. Tap them to open them.
Every main objective and its steps. A check mark appears as you finish each one.
Tap your Notes again to put them away. They're always one tap away.

lessons.title: SUPPLY COUNTER
lessons._note: T16 chest revision (user decision): after the Notes paper is opened and closed, the store is introduced before the town route. Without a counter (no clear spot), follow continues.

pages.text: See that stall beside the office? That's the Supply Counter.
Finish jobs and you earn coins. Spend them here on handy gear, like a bigger bag or a set of bookmarks.
Walk over and tap the counter to take a look.
Prices are in coins, and your coins show up right here. None yet, but that changes soon!
Browse as long as you like, then tap BACK.
Ta-da! The glowing arrows and the floating pin always lead to your next step.
Your goal pulses on the minimap too.
Follow the arrows. They lead to me!
Look at someone and tap to talk. The button at the bottom shows what a tap does.

lessons._note: 2026-10-27: shown in the first client chat (after Arthur's file), not over Arthur's own opening talk.

pages.text: Listen closely: what they tell you ends up on their ID.

lessons.title: ARTHUR'S FILE
lessons._note: T30 (2026-10-27): the file floats beside Arthur after his completed talk. The page ends only when the file was really collected (saved).

pages.text: Go on, tap the file to take it.

lessons.title: ARTHUR'S FILE
lessons._note: T30 (2026-10-27): one direct prompt; it resolves in walking and file-viewer modes so a quick first open cannot strand it.

pages.text: It's in your slots now. Tap it to open it.

lessons.title: ARTHUR'S FILE
lessons._note: 2026-10-27 (second pass): one hands-on step per page inside the open file, each shown by the hand on the real paper (record:* targets) and opening with Arthur's short reaction to the step before. Each waits for the real action (ArthurOpening flags); the flip and the stack also pass once the records are back, so nothing can strand the route.

pages.text: This page has his finished entries. The proof is on the next one: tap the arrow on the right.
His ID and background are clipped here. Drag one off the page.
That's it! Now the other one.
The ID gives his citizenship, the background where he lives. Tap the ID to flip it.
His profile's on the back. Now press and hold a paper, keep still for two seconds, and they stack.
Neat, right? Drag the stack back onto the page.

lessons.title: ARTHUR'S FILE
lessons._note: 2026-10-27: Arthur ties the proof to the finished entries in two lines, after the file turns back to page one.

pages.text: Filipino, but his home is abroad: that's his classification. And his own shop explains the other two.
Keep it handy. Now go meet the four clients: each will hand you a copy of their ID.
A copy of their ID! Tap it to pick it up.

lessons.title: TAXPAYER PROFILES
lessons._note: 2026-10-27: open, flip one, put away; the flip step also passes when the IDs are put away.

pages.text: It went into your Client IDs. Tap them to have a look.
Tap a card to flip it: their profile is on the back.
Tap the icon again to put them away. Three clients to go!

lessons.title: SIDE QUEST
lessons._note: T26: a follow-up with the same Arthur, not another introduction; the board talk itself is town.json arthurBoardIntro (three lines).

pages.text: That's all four IDs! Follow the arrows back to me.
Tap me, and we'll organize them on my corkboard.

lessons.title: THE CORKBOARD
lessons._note: T26 (2026-10-27): one target at a time: the CATEGORIES reference, reading an ID's back, the first drag, then how the check and the medal work.

pages.text: Each corner is a kind of taxpayer. CATEGORIES explains them any time.
Tap an ID to flip it and read the profile.
Now drag an ID onto the corner that fits.
Once all four are pinned, the board checks itself. That first check sets your medal: Gold for all four right, Silver for two, Bronze for fewer.
Your first medal! It shows your first check: Gold, Silver or Bronze. The EXP and hearts go to your progress. Have a look, then tap Continue.
Brilliant work! See your EXP and hearts go up? That's your side-quest reward.
Now for the real job. Follow the arrows to the office.

lessons.title: WELCOME TO THE OFFICE
lessons._note: Plays once, the first time the player walks into the office (the 'Go to the office' step is done), before the receptionist. 2026-10-27: three pages (was five).

pages.text: Welcome to the Town Tax Consultancy Office! This is where the real work happens.
Every working day starts here at reception with your case. Your desk is in the main room, and the Auditor checks finished cases in his office.
Lost? The minimap shows every room, and the arrows always lead to your next step.
Here we are! Tap the receptionist to say hi. She'll hand you today's case.
Uh-oh, a deadline! This shows when the Auditor leaves and how many minutes you have left.
Keep an eye on the clock on your minimap too. Hand in your case before he leaves and you'll earn an on-time bonus!
And if you miss it? Don't panic. He'll be back the next morning and your work stays put. You'd just lose the bonus. Now hurry!
Your desk is in the main office room. Follow the arrows, then tap the desk to sit down.
Your very own desk! Everything for Marie's case is right here.
Drag the Case Folder off the pile toward you to open it.

lessons.title: THE CASE FOLDER
lessons._note: 2026-10-27: Marie's folder works like Arthur's file (entries, then her ID and background). Each step is a short reminder that waits for the real action (CaseRecordsDesk flags, already true for a case under way). Arthur never names her entries.

pages.text: Same as my file, except these three entries are yours to fill.
Her ID and background are on the next page. Take both out.
Flip her ID: her profile from the plaza is on the back.
Got the details? Slide both back onto the page.
Now the rules. Drag the Tax Code Book toward you.

lessons._note: 2026-10-27: one page; the page arrows were met in Arthur's file.
lessons.title: TURNING PAGES

pages.text: The book turns pages like your folder, with the arrows on its edges. Section 1 is Taxpayer Classification, then Taxpayer Type, then Income Sources.

lessons.title: MOVING VALUES
lessons._note: 2026-10-27: four pages (the neat-part intro is folded into the first action).

pages.text: Values in the book go straight into her file. Tap one to pick it up.
Now tap the entry where it belongs. Green means it fits.
You can also drag a value straight onto an entry.
Careful: fitting isn't the same as right. Pick what really matches Marie.
That one doesn't go there. Look for a field of the same kind!

lessons.title: INVESTIGATE
lessons._note: 2026-10-27: one reminder (was a Profiles routine): the clients' IDs went onto the corkboard, and Marie's profile is on the back of her ID in her folder.

pages.text: Stuck? Her ID and background are on page two of her folder, and the book has the rules.
All three fields are filled in. Looking sharp!
When you're happy with your answers, your turn: drag the open folder onto an empty slot to keep it with you.
Folder's safe! Tap Exit Desk to stand up.
Last stop: the Auditor's office. Follow the arrows to the Auditor.
This is the Auditor. He checks every case before it's done. Tap him to start your hand-in.
He's asking for your case. Press and hold your Case Folder icon, then drag it onto the Auditor.
APPROVED! Every answer checks out. Tap the button, and the Auditor will finish up with you.
NEEDS ANOTHER LOOK. Each red line tells you where to look again, not the answer. Read them, then tap the button.
Still something to fix. Look only at the lines he marked this time, then tap the button.
Ah, the Auditor found a mistake or two. Happens to everyone, even me!
Marie is in the conference room. Talk to her again. She might remind you of something important.
And remember: the Auditor won't re-check the exact same answers. Change what he marked, keep the folder with you, then talk to him again.
Your folder is back on your desk. You've got this!

lessons.title: YOUR BAG
lessons._note: T10: HudHotbar raises cue:BagOverflow once, the first time an item lands in the bag because the bar is full (Bag icon never used yet). Completes on the real move (cue:BagItemToBar).

pages.text: Your bar is full, so it went in your bag. Tap the bag and drag it to your bar.
That's it! Everything in your bar is ready to use. Your bag keeps the rest safe.

lessons.title: YOUR BAG
lessons._note: Same moment when the Bag icon was already used: no arrow (cue:BagOverflowKnown).

pages.text: Your bar is full, so it went in your bag. Tap the bag and drag it to your bar.
Congratulations, rookie! That wraps up your first day. Take your time, then tap Continue to save and head to the level select.
